scope_executed.candidate_support: P100 only (Full-Candidate explicitly descoped, see full_candidate_feasibility below)

full_candidate_feasibility.reason: TRACK-EXPERT-V5-FULL01 measured ~98954s (~27.5h) for a single Full-Candidate Stage-1 cell; 3 seeds x 8 cells = 24 cells would require ~660 GPU-hours (~27.5 continuous days) on the single mandated GPU1, before downstream Mean-Mixture/Router/Stage-2 steps. Not a blocking error (experiment is possible), but empirically infeasible within this program's resource budget.

seed0_v5mm_stage2_gap_filled.resolution: Located correct V5 checkpoint/pool provenance (TRACK-HARD-EXPERT-V5-P100-ALLH01 checkpoint_selection, per run_aggregate_router_frozen01.sh line 56), ran build_v_meanmix_cache_pool01.py + eval_r_stage2_lambda_signfix01.py fresh at seed0
seed0_v5mm_stage2_gap_filled.verification: Resulting Aggregate MSE matches Phase2/3's reported V5 MM values to 5 decimal places at all 8 cells (e.g. ETTh1_96: 0.40980765 vs reported 0.40981)

PHASE4_CONTRIBUTION_REPRODUCES_REASONING: Only the internal-comparison criterion (Joint beats Hard backbone's own naive mixture, 7/8 cells at all 3 seeds) is robust. The deployment-relevant criterion (beats cheap V5 Mean-Mixture baseline on actual Stage-2 forecast MSE) is NOT robust: V5 MM has the best 8-cell-average Stage-2 MSE at every one of the 3 seeds tested, ahead of Hard MM, Frozen Router, and Joint Router alike.
final_case_determination: V5 (no Hard specialization, no Router at all) is best -> Hard-specialization-plus-Router contribution is NOT supported as a deployable method. Stronger negative result than 'Frozen approx Joint, prefer simpler' -- the simplest baseline in the whole comparison group wins.
